Description: A tweak plugin born for the free company 'The Holiest Fluffiness', now open for all to enjoy.
Changelog:
The About page now has a Changelog section with the last 10 releases. The newest one starts open, the older ones are collapsed, and the version you have installed is highlighted in gold. The notes are bundled with the plugin, so nothing is downloaded to show them.

Fixed a hook error in /xllog ("Hook verification failed" for the battle log). The critical heal sounds use this hook to tell your own heals apart from others', and it now matches what the game expects exactly, so it no longer passes a cut-off value back to the game.
